cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 46 on-track passes, 33 pit stops, 5 cars that never finished, 3 virtual safety cars.

cards.title: 13 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 21 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Alonso gained the most by the end of it, 4 places
7 cars started on intermediates
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: Stroll starts P22. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 68 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: 34 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Stroll lost 4 that way, more than anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 5 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Early on, with full tanks and the order still settling.

cards.title: 16 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: Lap 8: Bortoleto, leaving the track and gaining an advantage
6 ended in a penalty, 7 in no further action and 3 left for after the race

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: You are Antonelli, 1.2s behind Russell and going nowhere. Now what?
cards.text: Stuck behind another car your tyres overheat and the car will not turn. Stopping first gives you clean track for two or three laps, which is the whole trick behind the undercut.

choices.label: Box now and undercut
choices.sub: Fresh tyres, clean air, two laps to make it pay

choices.label: Stay out and overcut
choices.sub: Let him stop first, then push on an empty track

choices.label: Forget strategy, pass him
choices.sub: Send it and take the risk

outcomes.box: You spend about 25s in the lane and come out in traffic, betting that two fast laps on new tyres are worth more than the place you just gave up.
outcomes.wait: You stay on old rubber while he gets new ones, and you need clean air plus a mistake from him to make it work.
outcomes.attack: Passing a car with the same tyres on the same fuel is the hardest thing in the sport, and running into the back of him ends both races.

cards.reveal: Antonelli came in on lap 31, 21 laps after this, under the virtual safety car. He finished P1.

cards.title: 6 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 5 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Every one of them on track, with no stops around it.

cards.title: Albon is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 12 of 68, in a Williams.
bullets: P12 at the start of lap 11
Started P18
4 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: 6 penalties handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Hulkenberg: a 5s penalty for speeding in the pit lane
Piastri: a 10s penalty for causing a collision
Hadjar: a 10s penalty for more than one change of direction
And 3 more
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: Hamilton: 8 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 11 to lap 18, at racing speed.
bullets: 6 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Track steady around 17°C all race
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Norris: 8 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in a McLaren.
bullets: P3 on the grid, and did not reach the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Alonso is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 24 of 68, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: P17 at the start of lap 23
Started P19
3 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Lap 24: an incident between Antonelli and Russell at Turn 13. What do you give?
cards.text: Race control has flagged it and it lands on your desk. Same call the stewards had to make.

outcomes.none: You let it go. Nobody loses a place at a desk, and the driver behind spends the rest of the race on the radio.
outcomes.5: Five seconds gets added at the next stop, or to the final time if there is no stop left. Usually one position, sometimes none.
outcomes.10: Ten seconds is a real punishment and it almost always costs track position, which is why teams argue so hard about it.

cards.reveal: The stewards took no further action.

cards.title: 33 stops, and the busiest lap saw 6 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 30, with 6 cars in under the virtual safety car
Shortest time in the pit lane: Norris, 23.4s
Longest: Bearman, 44.9s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 6 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sector 11 saw 5 calls, more than anywhere else

cards.title: Russell is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 30 of 68, in a Mercedes.
bullets: P1 at the start of lap 29
Started P1
4 on-track passes before it happened
Race control logged an incident with Russell on lap 30

cards.title: Gasly hit 348 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Gasly did it in an Alpine
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Antonelli was leading when it was called
Perez, Bottas, Colapinto and 10 others stopped under it
Lifted on lap 32
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: Bottas stopped 4 times
cards.text: Four stops when most of the field made 1.
bullets: In on laps 3, 9, 29 and 49
2 of them under a safety car or VSC

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Perez, on lap 40 of 68. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Antonelli on lap 68, 1:14.210, in a Mercedes.

cards.title: Perez was P15 a lap before his race ended on lap 40. Where does he finish if it had not?
cards.text: Nobody can answer this one for certain. You have his own lap times to go on and nothing else.

choices.label: He stays about where he was

cards.reveal: Our read from his own lap times, not a fact. He was lapping 2.99s a lap slower than Antonelli, who went on to win it. With 28 laps left, "he stays about where he was" is the honest guess, and nobody gets to check.

cards.title: Antonelli had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Piastri went the other way: 7 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P4 on the grid, P11 at the flag
3 stops when most of the field made 1
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 68 of them

cards.title: Stroll: P22 on the grid, P15 at the flag
cards.text: 7 places gained.
bullets: 1 on-track pass along the way
5 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: Bortoleto ran one set for 49 laps
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the mediums, lap 18 to lap 66
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: Antonelli: 1:14.210
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Mercedes.
bullets: Set on lap 68 of 68, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Antonelli wins it
cards.text: P1 Antonelli · P2 Hamilton · P3 Verstappen.
bullets: After 68 laps, Hamilton crossed the line 10.768s behind

cards.title: How far behind was Hamilton at the flag?
cards.text: 68 laps, 1 hour 28 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
cards.reveal: 10.768 seconds after 68 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 25s today, which is 2 times the margin this race was decided by.
